item.title: 7 Steps That Help Make Opening a Franchise a More Confident Decision
item.description: Opening a franchise often brings a mixture of excitement and hesitation. item.title: South Carolina Mounts Two-Goal Comeback, Beat Greensboro in Overtime, 5-4
item.description: Trailing by two in the 3rd period, the South Carolina Stingrays overcame the multi-goal deficit, tying the game with 45 seconds left in regulation before Kaden Bohlsen won the game in overtime, beating the Greensboro Gargoyles, 5-4, on Friday evening

item.title: IAAM to Celebrate Giving Tuesday With Free Admission and Evening Gullah Storytelling Event
item.description: The International African American Museum (IAAM) will mark Giving Tuesday with a full day of community-focused programming on Tuesday, Dec. 2, including free museum admission and a special ticketed cultural event

item.title: Your Giving Tuesday Gift to Save Animals will be Doubled Up to $100,000
item.description: This Giving Tuesday, Charleston Animal Society is thrilled to announce an extraordinary $100,000 matching gift from anonymous “Friends of the Animals,” who hope to inspire the entire community to give generously to animals in need.

item.title: Online Strategies for Smart Financial Growth
item.description: The world of finance has transformed rapidly, with digital tools offering more opportunities than ever to grow wealth intelligently. From managing daily expenses to investing in high-yield assets, online platforms have simplified complex financial tasks, allowing individuals to make strategic decisions with precision. Smart financial growth requires more than luck; it demands awareness of trends, disciplined planning, and a willingness to explore unconventional avenues within the digital sphere.

item.title: Stingrays Drop Slugfest Against Solar Bears, 3-1
item.description: The South Carolina Stingrays fell to the Orlando Solar Bears, 3-1, on Saturday evening at the Kia Center to begin a three-game road trip.
